Arthur.day_scenario: Arthur rises at 6:00 AM to carefully prune the tomato vines in the back vegetable patch before the morning dew evaporates. Later, he settles into the sunroom with the Thursday paper and a wrench to tighten the loose hinge on the kitchen cabinet, keeping his tools neatly arranged in the drawer.

Martha.day_scenario: Martha steps onto the porch at 6:30 AM with a steaming mug of Earl Grey, quietly watching the cardinals at the feeder before the house stirs. Throughout the day, she sorts through the spice jars on the pantry shelves and stitches a new row onto her afghan, making sure her knitting basket and scissors are always returned to their designated spot.
